attempts.cause: The margin_pct function in margin_report package body incorrectly selects margin_pct from item_margins_v, which calculates margin based on a single average unit cost, leading to incorrect results when an item has multiple purchase records contributing to the average cost.
compile_errors: PACKAGE BODY MARGIN_REPORT line 23, col 5: PL/SQL: ORA-03048: SQL reserved word 'SELECT' is not syntactically valid following '...<identifier>'
PACKAGE BODY MARGIN_REPORT line 9, col 5: PL/SQL: SQL Statement ignored

attempts.cause: The margin_pct function in margin_report package body attempted to use SELECT statements directly within the function body without proper context or structure, leading to compilation errors.

The original implementation of margin_pct in the package body was flawed because it relied on selecting a pre-calculated margin_pct from item_margins_v, which was insufficient for correctly calculating margins when an item was bought in multiple deliveries, leading to incorrect negative margin results.
